title: Splat video
description: A phone clip rebuilt as moving Gaussian splats that play like the video, with sound. Moments crossfade and glide, the camera rides the original path, and dragging leans you off it while depth of field softens what the footage never saw.
intent: Puts Herb himself on the page as a video you can step into: 30 s streamed splats with audio as the clock, a still background stored once, and a real player interface (play, scrub, speed, sound, back to lens) on the light palette.
